name: Arista / VeloCloud
product_focus: VeloCloud SD-WAN portfolio now under Arista
evidence_summary: Arista announced acquisition of VeloCloud portfolio; VeloCloud architecture historically includes cloud-delivered SD-WAN gateways.
cost_model: Quote-based edge subscriptions/appliances/support; managed services commonly delivered by carriers/MSPs.
key_differentiators: VeloCloud was an early SD-WAN platform with strong cloud-delivered gateway architecture; now under Arista following the 2025 acquisition.
Multi-tenant design has made VeloCloud common in carrier and MSP managed services.
Application-aware routing and dynamic path selection are mature capabilities with substantial deployment history.
best_fit_for: Enterprises consuming VeloCloud through a managed service provider (Vodafone UK, others).
Service providers running multi-tenant SD-WAN at scale.
Buyers comfortable with a platform in transition under new ownership.
watch_outs: Platform is mid-transition from VMware/Broadcom to Arista; product roadmap, naming and integration story will evolve.
Security and SASE capabilities are largely partner-integrated rather than native.
Direct enterprise sales motion is less established than legacy vendors; most consumption is via managed providers.
verification_notes: Re-verified 2026-07-29 against named primary sources. Every graded fact carries a source, a tier and a verbatim quote confirmed present on the cited page by an independent check. Facts that could not be sourced are published as unknown with the reason stated. Sources found and rejected are listed in the evidence register at tier 4.

ai_capability.note: DMPO path analytics with Arista AVA AIOps; assistant capability maturing post acquisition.

resilience.note: 700+ gateways across 200+ PoPs give multi-gateway failover; HA edge pairs supported.

profile.platform_architecture: VeloCloud, now under Arista Networks after passing through VMware and Broadcom, popularised cloud-delivered SD-WAN: lightweight edges, a large fabric of cloud gateways (700+ across 200+ PoPs) and Dynamic Multipath Optimisation that remediates loss and jitter in real time. Orchestration is multi-tenant SaaS. Arista is integrating VeloCloud with its switching and observability portfolio under the CloudVision umbrella.
profile.security_sase: VeloCloud's native security covers stateful firewalling and segmentation, with SASE delivered through partner SSE integrations rather than a deep first-party stack; pairings with Zscaler, Netskope and Symantec are long established. Buyers wanting single-vendor SASE depth should look elsewhere; buyers wanting a proven network layer under best-of-breed SSE find VeloCloud a strong fit.
profile.service_support_channel: VeloCloud built the largest carrier managed-service footprint in SD-WAN: AT&T, Lumen, Colt, Vodafone and many others run VeloCloud-based offers, and that channel remains the most common consumption route. Direct and DIY are available with 24x7 vendor support. UK availability through carriers and MSPs is broad.
profile.commercials_verdict: Subscription per edge by bandwidth tier, quote based, historically aggressive through carrier deals. The Netify verdict: shortlist VeloCloud for branch-heavy estates on imperfect transport where DMPO still earns its keep, especially when buying through a carrier you already trust. Seek written clarity from Arista on roadmap and SSE strategy as the integration settles.

vendor_faqs.a: Broadcom acquired VMware and subsequently sold the VeloCloud SD-WAN business to Arista Networks. The platform, gateways and orchestration continue, with Arista integrating it alongside its switching and CloudVision tooling. Ask for current roadmap commitments during procurement.

vendor_faqs.q: How does DMPO improve application quality?
vendor_faqs.a: Dynamic Multipath Optimisation continuously measures each path, steers packets per application, and applies forward error correction and jitter buffering when links degrade. Voice and video stay usable on broadband-grade links, which built VeloCloud's reputation.

vendor_faqs.q: Is VeloCloud a full SASE platform?
vendor_faqs.a: Not single-vendor. Native security is firewalling and segmentation, with SSE delivered via partners such as Zscaler or Netskope. Treat VeloCloud as the network layer of a dual-vendor SASE rather than a one-stop security stack.

shortlist_summary: Arista acquired VeloCloud in 2025, bringing its strong cloud-delivered gateway architecture into the Arista portfolio, though the long-term product direction is worth clarifying with the vendor directly given how recent the acquisition is. Typically shortlisted by organisations already familiar with VeloCloud's architecture or those evaluating how VeloCloud capabilities will integrate with Arista's EOS and CloudVision portfolio going forward.
cost_note: Subscription per edge by bandwidth; historically aggressive through carrier deals.
uk_basis: No UK HQ (US). VeloCloud delivered in the UK through carriers including BT and Vodafone.

f01_fully_managed_service.quote: Cloud-native by design, VeloCloud SD-WAN is delivered via a global network of Edge PoPs, either self-managed or as a managed service.
f01_fully_managed_service.note: Arista authors the platform; the managed-service option is operated by MSP and service-provider partners rather than by Arista end to end. Arista's own press release quotes T&A SYSTEME GmbH, 'a German MSP managing 7500+ sites in 98 countries', and MetTel as the parties running the service for customers. No Arista-run design-to-report managed service was found.

f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.quote: Enterprises or their managed service providers can define business-level policies that apply enterprise-wide across many Edges
f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.note: Tenant isolation and delegated administration are evidenced by the multitenant Orchestrator, Controller and Gateway architecture and the three-tier RBAC model, and the partner programme carries 'SD-WAN MSP Partner Requirements'. Graded partial rather than yes because no page reviewed described branded or white-label partner portals, which the definition requires.

f05_professional_services_and_migration_.quote: Statement of Work - Professional Services - Universal Cloud Network (UCN) Deployment
f05_professional_services_and_migration_.note: Arista publishes named Statements of Work for professional services including deployment and a SOW service mapping guide.

f07_lifecycle_management.quote: Worldwide Advance Hardware Replacement and an option for onsite hardware replacement services.
f07_lifecycle_management.note: Confirmed verbatim 29 Jul 2026. Page also documents Next Business Day, 4 Hour and 2 Hour service levels.

f17_cellular_and_5g_support.quote: Dual Physical SIM + single eSIM (single standby)
f17_cellular_and_5g_support.note: The 7x0 datasheet documents an integrated Telit FN990A28 modem, 'LTE Category Cat-19', carrier aggregation, HSPA+ 3G fallback and a full 5G FR1 band list, with dual physical SIM plus eSIM. The product page states 'integrated WiFi and 5G' and the 4100/5100 page leads with 'Integrated 5G Enterprise-class SD-WAN appliances for branches'. LTE is also listed among supported WAN transports.

f19_public_cloud_gateways.quote: VeloCloud's cloud based architecture offers a unique footprint of more than 3,000 cloud gateways spanning 150+ SASE points of presence from VeloCloud and its partners around the world.
f19_public_cloud_gateways.note: This is VeloCloud's own gateway service infrastructure rather than a resold third party's, so it meets the definition. Two qualifications worth carrying forward: part of the estate is partner-hosted ('hosted by Arista/service providers or deployed on-premises'), and the security enforcement reached through those PoPs is supplied by third-party SSE vendors, not by Arista.

f20_private_pops_dedicated_pops.quote: Gateways can be deployed as partner Gateways on the premises of service providers, where they are managed by the service provider
f20_private_pops_dedicated_pops.note: Gateways are not restricted to a shared multi-tenant estate: the datasheet describes 'A distributed, global network of gateways, hosted by Arista/service providers or deployed on-premises' and lists 'Partner Gateway Support' as a feature, covering customer-hosted and dedicated partner deployments. No sovereign-region offering was named on the pages reviewed.

f21_private_global_backbone.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The SD-WAN solution page, the VeloCloud datasheet and the SD-WAN solution overview were each searched for backbone wording. The overview states gateways are 'deployed at top-tier network points of presence (PoPs) and in cloud data centers' and the datasheet lists broadband, MPLS, LTE and satellite as transports, but no source claims an Arista-owned or Arista-controlled inter-region backbone. Absence of a claim is not treated as absence of the capability.

f26_sla_backed_service_fabric.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The VeloCloud datasheet and the SD-WAN solution overview contain no occurrence of SLA, service level, uptime or availability. The support page documents 24x7x365 TAC coverage and A-Care advance hardware replacement, but no contractual uptime, response-time or change-handling commitments were published on any page reviewed and no SLA document was located.

f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.quote: Every VeloCloud edge device ships with an integrated stateful firewall to provide an extended security layer at the branch.
f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.note: Stateful layer 7 firewalling, IDS/IPS and URL filtering are built into the edge as the Enhanced Firewall Service, and the July 2026 release adds 'advanced firewalling and threat prevention capabilities, zone-based segmentation, Geo-IP filtering, DNS filtering'. Graded partial for two reasons: URL filtering and IP reputation are a third party's technology, since 'VeloCloud EFS includes URL filtering and IP reputation services powered by Webroot Brightcloud', and no malware inspection or sandboxing capability was evidenced on any page reviewed.

f33_data_loss_prevention.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The VeloCloud datasheet, the SD-WAN security page, the Edge Threat Management page and the July 2026 press release were each searched for DLP or data loss wording and returned none. The SASE integrations page names third-party SSE vendors including Zscaler and Netskope whose platforms would supply data protection, but no reviewed page states that content classification, inspection or blocking of sensitive data is delivered by Arista or through those integrations, so even a partner_integrated grade would be unsupported.

f40_managed_service_assurance.quote: Arista Global TAC provides you with 24x7x365 coverage for your product support needs around the world.
f40_managed_service_assurance.note: What is documented is a vendor technical assistance centre with round-the-clock coverage, which is reactive product support. No Arista NOC or SOC monitoring a customer's SD-WAN service proactively, owning incidents to root cause, or running structured service reviews and change governance was found. Proactive assurance is carried out by MSP partners such as MetTel and T&A SYSTEME GmbH. The Awake Labs security services page was checked for SOC and 24x7 wording and returned none.

delivery_model.quote: Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client to cloud networking for large data center/AI, campus and routing environments.
delivery_model.note: Arista authors and sells the VeloCloud SD-WAN platform and edge hardware; the company overview confirms it acquired the portfolio rather than operating a managed WAN service. Managed delivery is carried out by MSP and service-provider partners named in Arista's own press release (T&A SYSTEME GmbH, MetTel). No Arista-run managed WAN service description was found.

underlay_ownership.quote: flexible WAN choices, such as broadband, MPLS, LTE, and satellite
underlay_ownership.note: Arista sells edge hardware, software and cloud gateways and rides whatever transport the customer or their service provider supplies. No page reviewed offers Arista-supplied circuits or access, and the company overview describes a networking product business rather than a carrier. Where circuits are bundled it is the MSP partner, not Arista, supplying them.

sse_layer_ownership.quote: VeloCloud™ leverages a Best-of-Breed SASE strategy by combining its industry-leading SD-WAN with seamless integration of leading Security Service Edge (SSE) solutions.
sse_layer_ownership.note: The SSE stack is other vendors' technology integrated with VeloCloud SD-WAN, not built by Arista. Named partners on the pages reviewed: Zscaler, Netskope (Netskope One SSE), Palo Alto Networks (Prisma Access), Symantec (WSS), Forcepoint and Microsoft SSE. Arista builds the SD-WAN and the on-box Enhanced Firewall Service itself, but the cloud security edge is partner-supplied.

regulatory_documentation.quote: Customers provisioned in PCI-compliant PoPs will be provided with a PCI AoC which can be used to simplify and accelerate their own PCI audit.
regulatory_documentation.note: Found and documented: PCI DSS, with a named artefact, the Attestation of Compliance issued to customers in PCI-compliant PoPs, plus a published split of Arista, merchant and shared DSS responsibilities. Not found on any page reviewed: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIS2, DORA, NHS DSPT. The corporate responsibility page names only ISO 14001 for contract manufacturers, which is environmental, and the product certificate page is a model-number lookup form that rendered no framework names.

pop_count.quote: VeloCloud's cloud based architecture offers a unique footprint of more than 3,000 cloud gateways spanning 150+ SASE points of presence from VeloCloud and its partners around the world.
pop_count.note: Published as 150+ SASE points of presence, with more than 3,000 cloud gateways as the separate and larger figure. The count is explicitly a combined VeloCloud and partner footprint, so it is not purely Arista-operated infrastructure. The solution overview adds that gateways sit 'at top-tier network points of presence (PoPs) and in cloud data centers'.

sla_availability_pct.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. No availability percentage appears on the SD-WAN solution page, the VeloCloud datasheet, the SD-WAN solution overview or the customer support page. Targeted checks for the strings SLA, service level, uptime, availability and '99.' in the datasheet and the solution overview returned nothing, so there is not even a marketing mention of an SLA to downgrade from.

conflicts.claim_a: Arista states it acquired the VeloCloud SD-WAN portfolio from Broadcom in July 2025, making Arista the current owner and vendor.
conflicts.claim_b: The velocloud.com site still presents the product as 'VMware SD-WAN by VeloCloud', implying VMware ownership.

conflicts.claim_a: The SD-WAN solution page attributes the footprint to 'VeloCloud and its partners', implying a jointly operated gateway estate.
conflicts.claim_b: The datasheet describes gateways as 'hosted by Arista/service providers or deployed on-premises', which also allows entirely customer-hosted gateways that would not form part of the published shared footprint.
